name: EAF - Entity Attributes Field
description: Provides entity attributes field and features
provides_plugin_types: EntityAttribute (Plugin/EntityAttribute; PHP attribute Drupal\eaf\Attribute\EntityAttribute, legacy annotation Drupal\eaf\Annotation\EntityAttribute, interface Drupal\eaf\EntityAttributePluginInterface, manager service eaf.eaf_plugin_manager)
project_description: EAF (Entity Attributes Field) defines a 'field_attributes_storage' field type that stores a collection of non-content attributes (metadata such as CSS classes, alignment flags, full-width toggles, spacing options) about an entity, its fields, or individual field items. The attribute values are gathered by a single widget and persisted as a JSON string in one text column. Which attributes are offered is driven by an 'EntityAttribute' plugin type: the module ships an EntityCssClass plugin (free-text CSS classes, sanitized with Html::cleanCssIdentifier) and a FullWidth checkbox plugin, and site developers can add their own. The module exposes the stored attributes to the theme layer via preprocess hooks (preprocess_field, preprocess_node, preprocess_paragraph) so themes/templates can apply the classes and flags to markup; it ships no rendering template of its own. It has no routes, no permissions, no external dependencies, and no Drush commands.
